title: Signal or Story?
details: All twelve original team routes, interview responses, evidence, confidence boundaries and token costs are retained. Native calculations match 1,080 independent Python route/choice outcomes. The browser completed every route with deliberately weak pressure/judgment choices and both revisions, plus a two-question/two-source route with reserved mandatory actions. The original step display uses a native progress element. Zero-question evidence downgrading and token reserves are covered by engine tests.
compatibility: Signal remains session-only. Refreshing, opening an old or native bookmark, or closing the tab starts fresh. No local storage, URL state saving or central service is added. Back/Forward within the open session preserve drafts, histories and earned progress. Earlier pages expose no mutation actions or new evidence.
